extracted.intended_audience: readers of Mark Twain; literary and humor enthusiasts; attendees of late-19th/early-20th speaking events
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of humorous speeches and short entertaining anecdotes delivered by Mark Twain (Samuel Clemens) to literary clubs, banquets, and civic bodies around 1874–1908. Material is narrative, anecdotal humor and occasional social/political commentary intended for public audiences.
